boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Sprague Library environments for quiet work, group projects, and media-focused study.

cards.title: Lower Level Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Lower Level
cards.notes: Set up among the R–Z book area when you want a designated silent-study setting. Bring materials first, then choose an open desk booth.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level silent area beside the R–Z collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Sprague Library identifies an additional silent-study space on the Lower Level in the R–Z book area and shows desk booths there.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in silent-study space in Sprague Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Silent Study Overlooking Cole Hall
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Upper Level, south end
cards.notes: Use the upper-level overlook on the Cole Hall side for silent work. Pick a seat along the south end and keep calls for another area.
cards.short_summary: Silent seating with a view over Cole Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes large silent and quiet study spaces on the upper level overlooking Cole Hall at the south end.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in silent/quiet study area; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Silent Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Upper Level
cards.notes: Choose a carrel on the upper level for a contained individual-work setup. Keep your plan to quiet reading, drafting, or problem sets.
cards.short_summary: Upper-level individual carrels in a silent-study area.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists large upper-level silent and quiet study areas and documents Silent Study Carrels among its study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in silent/quiet study area; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Commuter Study Space
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · First Floor, south wing
cards.notes: Head to the south-wing room for outlets, a large group table, and height-adjustable tables. It is near Print, Laptop Lending, and CAST.
cards.short_summary: A bright first-floor room with charging and adjustable tables.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes the Commuter Study Space as a first-floor south-wing room with outlets, a group table, and height-adjustable tables.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in space; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Room 201 Group Study
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Upper Level
cards.notes: Reserve Room 201 for an academic group session and use its table-and-monitor setup to share a screen while you work through material together.
cards.short_summary: A reservable upper-level room with a monitor.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Room 201 as a Sprague Library group study room and documents it with a table, chairs, and monitor.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries. Group rooms are intended for Montclair State students, faculty, and staff doing academic activities.

cards.title: Room 027 Collaborative Space
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Lower Level, Multimedia
cards.notes: Book this multimedia collaboration room when your project needs a shared display, whiteboard, or videoconference hardware. Plan an academic group task.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level collaborative room with display and whiteboard tools.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries states that Room 027 has a 65-inch Sony 4K TV, whiteboard, Polycom camera, and AirMedia controller.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries; collaborative spaces are available to students, faculty, and staff for group assignments, media projects, or videoconferencing.

cards.title: Creative Collaboration Pod
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Collaborative Spaces
cards.notes: Reserve the pod for a compact team work session. Use the monitor, whiteboard walls, power outlets, and USB ports to keep a shared project moving.
cards.short_summary: A reservable pod with a monitor, whiteboard walls, and power.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies the Creative Collaboration Pod as having a 55-inch monitor, whiteboard walls, power outlets, and USB ports.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries; intended for academic group work, media projects, and videoconferencing.

cards.title: Group Study Pod #1
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · First Floor
cards.notes: Reserve the first-floor pod for a small project meeting. Connect to its shared monitor, outline ideas on the whiteboard wall, and plug in devices.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor reservable pod for shared-screen coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Group Study Pod #1 on the first floor and states that group study pods have a monitor, whiteboard walls, power, and USB ports.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries; intended for academic group work, media projects, and videoconferencing.

cards.title: Viewing Room 001
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Viewing Rooms
cards.notes: Reserve this small viewing room for a focused media assignment or a compact group study session. Keep your group to the room’s one-to-four-person capacity.
cards.short_summary: A small reservable room for media viewing or group study.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists Room 001 among five viewing rooms for videotapes, DVDs, or group study, each sized for one to four students.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries; viewing rooms are small and may be used by one to four students.

cards.title: The Sensory Space
cards.subtitle: Sprague Library · Room 030, Lower Level Multimedia
cards.notes: Reserve Room 030 when a calm, sensory-supportive study setting fits your work. Keep the visit within two hours and take Zoom calls elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A reservable sensory-supportive retreat with privacy seating.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes Room 030 as a sensory-supportive retreat and states that it may be booked for a maximum of two hours; Zoom calls are not permitted.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through University Libraries for up to two hours. Zoom calls are not permitted inside; use a private study room for calls.
